description: Gustave Doré, Bible illustrations (1866), from the Internet Archive item "gustavedore". Images are linked, never copied: pages load them from the Internet Archive IIIF Image API (v2; v3 is the fallback). "number" and "title" are the Archive.org file name as uploaded; they are not Doré's 1866 plate numbers or captions. scripture_ref is set only where the title names one passage. It is identified from the title, not printed on the plate. A chapter-level ref is used when the title gives the book and chapter and the scene is not pinned to verses. A person is linked only when the plate draws that person: basis named-in-title (the name is in the file title and the person is drawn) or depicted (the person is clearly the figure shown, with a short note of who and where). An event is linked when the plate draws that event (event-depicted). A person is not linked only because a verse names them. This file has the 220 canonical plates. The 21 Apocrypha files, marked with an x after the number, are omitted.
